side.title: Urgent jobs reach you first.
side.body: One account for job alerts, applications and messages, on any phone or computer.

points.fast: Urgent alerts by SMS or WhatsApp, the moment a job is posted
points.safe: Scam messages are stopped before they reach you
points.control: You choose how and when we contact you

side.secure: Your account is protected by a code on new phones and computers.

login.title: Log in
login.intro: Type your email address or phone number.
login.identifierInvalid: Type an email address like name@gmail.com, or a Kenyan mobile number like 0712 345 678.
login.capsLock: Caps Lock is on: your password may be typed in capital letters.
login.forgotHint: Not right twice. If you have forgotten your password, you can set a new one by email.
login.notFoundPhone: A phone number only works here after it was confirmed with a code. You can also log in with your email address.
login.rememberedIntro: Enter your password to log in as {{to}}.

code.chooseTitle: Where should we send your code?
code.chooseIntro: Hello {{name}}. This is a new phone or computer, so we check that it is really you.
code.sentSms: We sent a 6-digit code by SMS to {{to}}.
code.sentEmail: We sent a 6-digit code to {{to}}. If it is not in your inbox, check the spam folder.
code.label: 6-digit code
code.help: It works for 5 minutes. You can paste it.
code.remember: Remember this phone or computer for 30 days
code.rememberHelp: You will not need a code here next time. Do not tick this on a shared computer.
code.resendIn: Send a new code in {{seconds}} s

register.title: Create your account
register.workerHelp: Get job alerts and apply in one tap.
register.businessHelp: Post jobs and find workers fast.
register.emailIntro: We will send a code to it, to check that it is yours.
register.existsBody: {{email}} already has a KaziForce account. Log in instead: it keeps all your alerts.
register.name: Your full name
register.nameHelp: Employers and workers will see this name.
register.passwordHelp: Press Show to check what you typed.
register.passwordCommon: This password is too easy to guess. Try a few words together, like a short sentence.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.intro: Enter your email. We will send you a link to set a new password.
forgot.sent: If an account uses this email, we have sent a link to it. Check your inbox and spam folder.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.done: Your password has been changed. You can now log in.
reset.missingToken: This link is not complete. Ask for a new one.

demoCode.title: Demo code
demoCode.help: For the presentation, the code is shown here instead of being sent by SMS or email.
